messages:
nicole_csm: FYI MosaicForms renewal ~39d out. Usage dropped ~47% last 30d (active seats 260 -> 138). Champion moved to another team.
ops-bot: Alert UDA-20260510-02: acct_mosaicforms -47% 30d vs baseline.
dave_ae: any error telemetry or billing flags? procurement mentioned a competitor demo but no RFP yet.
sam_se: integration health shows webhook validation failures and a burst of 502/504s plus a handful of 429s. snippet: ```2026-05-10T08:12:03Z WARN 502 /v1/webhook acct=mosaicforms req=hb-22
2026-05-10T08:12:04Z ERROR 504 /v1/webhook acct=mosaicforms req=hb-23
2026-05-10T08:13:21Z ERROR 429 /v1/generate acct=mosaicforms pid=gw-09```
nicole_csm: new contact listed in Okta as "P. Ortega"; outreach so far no response.
kevin_director: prioritize a two-track response: (1) infra triage to confirm and remediate lost requests; (2) CSM/AE outreach offering SE hours to finish integration + a short commercial incentive if they extend.
dave_ae: approved offering up to 10 SE hours and a 2-week credit if they commit to a 6-month term. Hold final terms until root cause confirmed.
sam_se: I'll run a focused health audit on gw-09 and webhook proxy, ETA 4h. If errors are on our edge we can backfill failed callbacks and produce a remediation note.
nicole_csm: action assignments: sam -> audit & log summary by EOD, dave -> contact procurement and new PM, nicole -> prepare renewal-risk brief for execs. I'll create SF renewal_watch ticket.
ops-bot: Reminder: create renewal_watch ticket in Salesforce (acct_mosaicforms, renewal_39d)  ticket #RW-20260510-14
nicole_csm: created ticket RW-20260510-14 and linked playbook onboarding-rescue-v3. Will update this thread after audit. :white_check_mark:
